summary: Iteration 3 tests roadmap feature. Added TestRoadmap class to /app/backend/tests/test_autodelegate.py covering 400 (not analyzed), 404 (missing meeting), full analyze->roadmap happy path with deep structural assertions (project_name, objective, recommended_stack items with https urls, phases with milestones+tasks+owner+deadline+recommended_tools https urls, risks) and GET persistence. All 23 pytest tests PASS (regression + new roadmap). Frontend UI: verified via Playwright that (a) loading an already-roadmapped meeting from History renders roadmap-section directly with no CTA, and (b) an analyzed-only meeting shows the CTA, clicking generate-roadmap-button transitions to 'Planning…' loading state, POST /api/generate-roadmap returns 200 (~40s), and the roadmap-section renders recommended-stack-card, roadmap-phase-i, roadmap-task-i-j, roadmap-risks-card, and stack-item-0 with a real https href to atlassian.com/software/jira with target=_blank.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py analyze-meeting always overwrites participants/summary etc.; re-running analyze on a meeting with a roadmap does NOT clear the stale roadmap. Consider clearing meeting.roadmap on re-analyze OR always regenerating so users don't see a roadmap tied to old actions.

generate_roadmap trusts the LLM's URLs (no validation that url starts with https:// or that domain is reachable). The prompt asks for real tools with correct URLs but a defensive filter would be safer.
http timeout in frontend/src/lib/api.js is 120s; roadmap LLM calls can approach 60-90s. Safe today but no user-facing retry if it times out.
seed_data_creation: Created two test meetings via API (TEST_UI_cta_project analyzed-only, TEST_UI_prerm_project analyzed+roadmapped) plus TEST_campus_food_project used by pytest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Roadmap endpoint POST /api/generate-roadmap and RoadmapSection UI are fully working. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_autodelegate.py covers all endpoints (meetings CRUD, analyze, edit/execute action, slack routing, upload-audio bad ext, and roadmap). Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL for API tests; LLM calls take up to ~60s, use generous timeouts.
